title: The Beetle in Jewel Colors
youtube_title: The Beetle in Jewel Colors | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Femi finds a beetle green as a bottle, crossing a leaf. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Femi shows Ren how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
